Description: What a quad toe stop is really for: not a brake, but a fixed point that does not roll, says the skater behind this site, who learned on quads. Title: Push Off the Toe Stop: The Thing That Stops You Rolling Makes You Fast
Description: The most counter-intuitive use of a quad toe stop is acceleration. The skater behind this site, who learned on quads, says it plainly: you can use the front stop for strong pushes to pick up speed. The reason is the same one that lets it hold you still — without a point that does not roll, you cannot push hard against anything. Plant it, push, roll off onto the wheels.
